name: document-layout
title: Document Layout
description: A page read as a document — the title area, the text at a reading measure, what follows it, a contents column and a comment margin — on one grid with four tiers by its own width, plus its skeleton and a tier hook.

meta.whenToUse: A page people read and write as a document (a wiki page, a spec, a public page, a version's full view): the text at a calm measure with a contents list and a comment margin when there is room, and its loading skeleton on the same grid.
meta.whenNotToUse: A record page with a rail of property cards (RecordLayout), a form or settings page (AppShellPage size="prose"), or a list.
